findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy
findings.description: The application does not implement a Content-Security-Policy header.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The application can potentially be embedded in external websites.
findings.recommendation: Set the X-Frame-Options header to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.description: Directory indexing is enabled on one or more paths.
findings.recommendation: Disable directory indexing on the web server.
